summary: Fixed _run_nsga3 and _run_nsga2_fallback to reset restart_count and post_restart_gens_remaining in the reset_plateau block. Previously only plateau_best_progress, plateau_streak, post_restart_no_improve_streak, and post_restart_best_progress were reset. Added generation_offset to startup log so resumed island epochs are distinguishable. Added 2 tests (138 lines) verifying reset_plateau=True clears counters and reset_plateau=False preserves them.
notes: Global/non-island evolution unchanged: reset_plateau=False preserves all counters as before.
Test uses run_phase2_evolution_epoch with FakeEngine to exercise _run_nsga3 end-to-end without GPU.
plateau_best_progress can be updated by the evolution loop during generation 0 (normal behavior); only restart counters are guaranteed reset by reset_plateau.
The _run_nsga2_fallback reset_plateau block is now comprehensive for defensive consistency, though this function is never called with resumed state (always starts fresh).
No changes to phase2_rule_pool.py, evaluator_v5.ipynb, or any other files.
